title: Two suite tests fail on a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf, before and after #257: private-draft byte count (438 vs 384) and git update-ref --stdin in the legacy multi-ref push test
observation: Observed 2026-09-15 on Windows 11, git with 'LF will be replaced by CRLF' warnings, Node 24.13. Full `npm test` fails 3 tests locally while CI (ubuntu, Node 22/24) and platform-matrix-safety (windows-latest) are green. Bisected by running the two fast ones on the pre-#257 commit 8458255 in a separate worktree: same two failures, so they predate the task-episode work. (1) test/external-acceptance.test.ts:84 'the CLI creates a private draft and refuses to overwrite it' asserts a byte length of 384 and gets 438: 54 extra bytes, consistent with CRLF line endings on a 54-line file; the assertion should compare content or normalize newlines. (2) test/sync.test.ts:618 'large legacy multi-ref push keeps its successful outcome when observation output is oversized' fails with `git update-ref --stdin` exit 128 (stdout/stderr null), likely stdin size or newline handling on Windows git; needs the stderr captured to diagnose. (3) test/agent-farm-season.test.ts 'season: 21 simulated days' took 464 s and failed under CPU contention from parallel runs; not reproduced alone. Impact: the local verification launcher records exit 1 for the full suite on this machine, so contribution cards say 'failed' for a suite that is green in CI. Options: normalize line endings in the two tests (autocrlf-proof), or set `* text=auto eol=lf` in .gitattributes for the repo.
